setup: (fset 'my-when (if (fboundp 'defmacro) (cons 'macro (lambda (c b) (list 'if c b))) (macro (c b) (list 'if c b))))
note: 10B: the same rule for an alias whose target is bound to nothing at all. Emacs answers `(dangling 1)`, not `(no-such-name 1)`: an alias chain that does not reach a macro is not an expansion step. The setup is dialect-neutral by construction: Emacs stores a macro as a `(macro . FUNCTION)` cons in the function cell and fe has a distinct macro object, so each transformer is installed through whichever spelling the running dialect has, selected by `(fboundp 'defmacro)` -- t in Emacs, nil in standalone fe. Nothing else about the case differs between the sides.
